description: Search EU CTIS trial overviews by condition, sponsor, country, or public status. Country is applied to the overview list because the public API has no reliable country parameter. Requests past the 10,000-row cap are read from the opposite sort order. This does not return site rows; use get_eu_trial_sites for those.

condition.description: Medical condition, for example multiple sclerosis.

country.description: EEA country name or code, for example France or FR.

status.description: Public status label or code 1-12, for example "Ongoing, recruiting" or 4.

name: search_eu_trials
title: Search EU trials
